newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse to firm cautiously on Dow rise.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse to firm cautiously on Dow rise.

text.p: 0740 GMT - Bel-20 index .BFX to edge up after 179 point surge in Dow Jones Industrial Average .DJI, support from bonds, but players wary in view of May Day holiday Thursday and many likely to take Friday off for four-day weekend.
* Bel-20 ended Tuesday 0.80 percent higher at closing high of 2,234.98 but off intraday high of 2,241.72.
